app.name: CS Agent - Priority & Reply
app.short_description: Priority evaluation and AI reply suggestion for tickets.
app.long_description: Sidebar app: evaluates ticket priority (P0–P3), translates last message, summarizes ticket, suggests reply. Fill reply box or one-click send.
app.installation_instructions: Install the app, then set **backend_url** to your backend API base URL (e.g. https://your-backend.com). Ensure the backend is running and reachable from Zendesk.

backend_url.label: Backend URL
backend_url.helpText: Base URL of the CS Agent backend (e.g. https://your-server.com). Must be HTTPS in production.
